title: Is your power bill really frozen?
briefing: Power bills in New Jersey. Four posts. I may have touched a few. Or none.

posts.body: The Board of Public Utilities on Thursday pledged no net increase in electricity rates for New Jersey's four regulated utilities.

quote.text: Taken together with the items on the agenda earlier this month, these actions will result in no net increase in electricity rates and a slight decrease in gas rates.
quote.speaker: Ben Hertz-Shargel, NJBPU President

posts.body: NJ power prices are up 27% in ONE YEAR. Share before your next bill hits.
…New Jersey electricity bills jumped roughly 20 percent last year, driven in large part by rising costs in PJM's capacity market.

quote.text: I don't know if everyone in New Jersey understands, but it is the most expensive hours of the year that are driving the really unsustainable price hikes in the utility and electricity bills that we saw in the last few years.
quote.speaker: Emma Rebhorn, BPU Commissioner
